messages:
erin: I opened a small PR to standardize the function/tool-calling examples and fix a few broken anchors from the recent reorg: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123. Main asks: pick a canonical wrapper, add tiny py/js snippets, and sweep stale anchors.
paul: Link thanks. What wrapper are you proposing? envelope/frame/other?
erin: Proposing `call_frame` to be explicit. Keeps metadata separate. I'll add a one-paragraph migration note and a parseCallFrameFallback() helper.
mina: I can add the snippets in docs/snippets/call_frame (python.md + node.md). Each will show generate + parse fallback usage. Also include a note about nullable arrays (results may be null vs []).
paul: For anchors: the site build failed on a couple of links that referenced /docs/structured-output#json-shape which is now /docs/structured-output#json-shape-stable. I'll run a grep+replace and open a tiny linkfix PR and add a link-check test for header ids.
erin: Perfect. Draft schema I put in the PR: {"type":"object","properties":{"call_frame":{"type":"object","properties":{"tool":{"type":"string"},"params":{"type":["object","null"]}},"required":["tool"]}},"required":["call_frame"]}.
mina: LGTM. I'll push snippets later today and reference the schema id in the examples.
docs-bot: Staging deploy: successful  link-check queued.
ci-bot: Note: link-check will block merges with unresolved anchors.
paul: I'll wait for snippets then run link-check locally and push anchor fixes.
erin: Thanks—I'll merge once link-check is green and snippets are present. :thumbsup:
